zh-CN.name: Archify
zh-CN.shortDesc: 把代码库或系统描述编译成可交互、可校验的图（架构/流程/时序/数据流/生命周期/ER/类/树/时间线/瀑布），或做成一页式讲解页，产出自带动效、可导出的单文件 HTML/SVG，适配 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor。需 Node.js 18+ 与本地 Chrome、Chromium 或 Edge；交付时会做有限的上游更新检查，主动讲解模式仅在用户同意后写入智能体全局规则。

en-US.name: Archify
en-US.shortDesc: Compile a codebase or system description into interactive, verifiable diagrams (architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, lifecycle, ERD, class, tree, timeline, waterfall) or a one-page explainer — self-contained HTML/SVG with motion and export, for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Requires Node.js 18+ and a local Chrome, Chromium or Edge; delivery runs a bounded upstream update check, and proactive explainer mode edits the agent's global rules only after the user agrees.
